verses.text: Oh give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples.
verses.textZh: 你們要稱謝耶和華，求告他的名，在萬民中傳揚他的作為！

verses.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; Speak of all His wonders.
verses.textZh: 要向他唱詩歌頌，談論他一切奇妙的作為！

verses.text: Glory in His holy name; Let the heart of those who seek the LORD be glad.
verses.textZh: 要以他的聖名誇耀！尋求耶和華的人，心中應當歡喜！

verses.text: Seek the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.
verses.textZh: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，時常尋求他的面。

verses.text: Remember His wonders which He has done, His marvels and the judgments uttered by His mouth,
verses.textZh: 他僕人亞伯拉罕的後裔，他所揀選雅各的子孫哪，你們要記念他奇妙的作為和他的奇事，並他口中的判語。

verses.text: O seed of Abraham, His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.textZh: a

verses.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.textZh: 他是耶和華─我們的神；全地都有他的判斷。

verses.text: He has remembered His covenant forever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations,
verses.textZh: 他記念他的約，直到永遠；他所吩咐的話，直到千代─

verses.text: [The] [covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac.
verses.textZh: 就是與亞伯拉罕所立的約，向以撒所起的誓。

verses.text: Then He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.textZh: 他又將這約向雅各定為律例，向以色列定為永遠的約，

verses.text: Saying, 'To you I will give the land of Canaan As the portion of your inheritance,'
verses.textZh: 說：我必將迦南地賜給你，作你產業的分。

verses.text: When they were only a few men in number, Very few, and strangers in it.
verses.textZh: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少，並且在那地為寄居的。

verses.text: And they wandered about from nation to nation, From [one] kingdom to another people.
verses.textZh: 他們從這邦遊到那邦，從這國行到那國。

verses.text: He permitted no man to oppress them, And He reproved kings for their sakes:
verses.textZh: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們，為他們的緣故責備君王，

verses.text: 'Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.'
verses.textZh: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，也不可惡待我的先知。

verses.text: And He called for a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.
verses.textZh: 他命饑荒降在那地上，將所倚靠的糧食全行斷絕，

verses.text: He sent a man before them, Joseph, [who] was sold as a slave.
verses.textZh: 在他們以先打發一個人去─約瑟被賣為奴僕。

verses.text: They afflicted his feet with fetters, He himself was laid in irons;
verses.textZh: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳；他被鐵鍊捆拘。

verses.text: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的話試煉他，直等到他所說的應驗了。

verses.text: The king sent and released him, The ruler of peoples, and set him free.
verses.textZh: 王打發人把他解開，就是治理眾民的，把他釋放，

verses.text: He made him lord of his house And ruler over all his possessions,
verses.textZh: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，

verses.text: To imprison his princes at will, That he might teach his elders wisdom.
verses.textZh: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰，將智慧教導他的長老。

verses.text: Israel also came into Egypt; Thus Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.textZh: 以色列也到了埃及；雅各在含地寄居。

verses.text: And He caused His people to be very fruitful, And made them stronger than their adversaries.
verses.textZh: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多，使他們比敵人強盛，

verses.text: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
verses.textZh: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓，並用詭計待他的僕人。

verses.text: He sent Moses His servant, [And] Aaron, whom He had chosen.
verses.textZh: 他打發他的僕人摩西和他所揀選的亞倫，

verses.text: They performed His wondrous acts among them, And miracles in the land of Ham.
verses.textZh: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟，在含地顯他的奇事。

verses.text: He sent darkness and made [it] dark; And they did not rebel against His words.
verses.textZh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；沒有違背他話的。

verses.text: He turned their waters into blood And caused their fish to die.
verses.textZh: 他叫埃及的水變為血，叫他們的魚死了。

verses.text: Their land swarmed with frogs [Even] in the chambers of their kings.
verses.textZh: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室，青蛙多多滋生。

verses.text: He spoke, and there came a swarm of flies [And] gnats in all their territory.
verses.textZh: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來，並有虱子進入他們四境。

verses.text: He gave them hail for rain, [And] flaming fire in their land.
verses.textZh: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨，在他們的地上降下火燄。

verses.text: He struck down their vines also and their fig trees, And shattered the trees of their territory.
verses.textZh: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹，毀壞他們境內的樹木。

verses.text: He spoke, and locusts came, And young locusts, even without number,
verses.textZh: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來，不計其數，

verses.text: And ate up all vegetation in their land, And ate up the fruit of their ground.
verses.textZh: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬和田地的出產。

verses.text: He also struck down all the firstborn in their land, The first fruits of all their vigor.
verses.textZh: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子，就是他們強壯時頭生的。

verses.text: Then He brought them out with silver and gold, And among His tribes there was not one who stumbled.
verses.textZh: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來；他支派中沒有一個軟弱的。

verses.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the dread of them had fallen upon them.
verses.textZh: 他們出來的時候，埃及人便歡喜；原來埃及人懼怕他們。

verses.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to illumine by night.
verses.textZh: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋，夜間使火光照。

verses.text: They asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.textZh: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來，並用天上的糧食叫他們飽足。

verses.text: He opened the rock and water flowed out; It ran in the dry places [like] a river.
verses.textZh: 他打開磐石，水就湧出；在乾旱之處，水流成河。

verses.text: For He remembered His holy word [With] Abraham His servant;
verses.textZh: 這都因他記念他的聖言和他的僕人亞伯拉罕。

verses.text: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with a joyful shout.
verses.textZh: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出，帶領選民歡呼前往。

verses.text: He gave them also the lands of the nations, That they might take possession of [the fruit of] the peoples' labor,
verses.textZh: 他將列國的地賜給他們，他們便承巡蛦民勞碌得來的，

verses.text: So that they might keep His statutes And observe His laws, Praise the LORD!
verses.textZh: 好使他們遵他的律例，守他的律法。你們要讚美耶和華！
